limits: Three streams, two cell definitions and two noise levels; not an independently randomized coverage study.
All parameters stationary; no aging claim.
Original Gaussian and mixture local surrogates remain overconfident on some paths.
Event detector has24-record horizon and only step/first-order templates.
No samples duplicated or dropped from committed likelihood; mixture downweights rather than discards.
Offline schedule shuffles control grouping but are not a deployable scheduler.

storage.detector_implementation: NumPy/Python desktop reference; native RTL timing unmeasured

findings: Universal12-record retirement worsens original-noise capacity endpoints on all three streams. Alignment within24-record tiles does not overcome that grouping effect.
Sparse VI improves final and late errors on lower-noise cellB/multiscale control, but worsens accurate owner seed1000 and barely changes seed1006. No universal scheduling improvement.
Scale mixture protects fixed16 from declared additive glitches on both20mV owner streams, but does not improve every parameter endpoint on2mV control.
Current-only alignment is competitive; additional VI information is not consistently beneficial with exact measured current.
Uncertainty overconfidence persists; no aging or deployment qualification.
decision: Keep production fixed16/Gaussian defaults. Retain sparse scheduling and explicit measurement mixture as separate experimental candidates; do not promote coupled changes.
additional_control: CellB,multiscale0.2/2/20/120s pulse pairs,2mV noise,seed2000;4h fit plus30min holdout. Source generated separately using existing scalar plant and public harness.
fault_scope: Post-hoc additive voltage glitches at rate.001, broad component20xreported sigma. Not bit-accurate ADC faults; recorded current/controller behavior unchanged. No injected labels enter estimation.
